Name: (CP) Upgraded Casks
Author: CyanFire
Description:
Upgraded versions of the original Casks, with improved space efficiency. By default, the casks come in Copper which take a stack of 1-10 of the same item, Iron which takes 11-25, Gold which takes 26-50 and Iridium which takes 51-100. If enabled in the config, there is also a Prismatic version which takes 101-200.

The config has many options for customisation, including but not limited to: custom recipes for each cask, custom prices for each cask, custom capacity for each cask & global aging multiplier modifiers.


Based off of the same ideas as Upgraded Jars & Upgraded Kegs, the Custom Farming Redux mods


Heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8416]PFM - Expanded Casks[/url] by Epsilon so much so that the sprites are actually from that mod! The difference with this mod is that they behave exactly like the vanilla casks so you don't have to re-insert the items after they reach each quality level!


Purchase the crafting recipe for them from Clint. The first tier becomes available when the vanilla casks are unlocked.



Requires Custom Cask Mod aswell as Content Patcher & SMAPI as it's not possible to register the Big Craftables as Casks with CP alone. Now also needs selph’s Extra Machine Config too.



Compatible with all modded items as the mod copies it's rules from the vanilla casks.
